name: Thaw
summary: Auros time folds back: those frozen in stasis move again.

face.name: Thaw

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: At the start of each of your turns untap the entities you control that are stuck in stasis: Stasis no longer keeps them tapped forever, and they are free to attack and block again.

face.flavor: Stasis is not death. It is only a long winter.
